lines.description: The receipt's lines after the scan.

earliestExpiry.description: The earliest expiry (AI 17) of the accepted cartons of the line (ADR 0024). Absent when none carried one.

lpn.description: The SSCC, or an internal `LPN-<ulid>` for a carton received without one.

kind.description:
`HOMOGENEOUS_CASE` = one SKU in a case pack; `MIXED` = several SKUs, a

kind.title: CartonKind

condition.description: Whether received units are fit to stock. Only `Good` is handed to inventory-storage.
condition.title: Condition

ssccSource.description: Who gave the carton its SSCC (ADR 0024). Absent on a carton that has none.

bestBefore.description: AI 15 of the scanned label (a day 00 is the last day of the month). Absent when the label had none.

shipForGln.description: AI 413 of the scanned label; stored, never enforced.

kind.description:
Raised on `CartonDiscrepancyRaised`, never on `ReceiptClosed`.
`UnexpectedCarton` = an SSCC not on the manifest; `MissingCarton` = a
manifest carton never accepted (raised at close); `DuplicateSscc` =
scanned twice or already received; `UnknownGtin` = a GTIN the
PackagingView does not know; `CaseQtyMismatch` = quantity differs from
the active CASE units per pack or the label count;
`MixedCaseDeclaredAsCasePack` = the label's content contradicts the
manifest SKU; `UnlabelledCarton` = a case with no SSCC against a carton
ASN (it gets an internal LPN, see the label endpoint);
`CartonOverLimit` = the carton's DECLARED `grossWeightG` or longest
`dims` side is above `CARTON_MAX_GROSS_WEIGHT_G` /
`CARTON_MAX_LONGEST_SIDE_MM` (the carton is still ACCEPTED;
`expected` holds the breached limits and `actual` the declared values,
as `grossWeightG:<n>` / `longestSideMm:<n>` joined by commas);
`MixedCartonContentMismatch` = the `countedContents` of a MIXED carton
differ from its manifest for a SKU (`expected` and `actual` are
`<sku>:<qty>`, one finding per SKU);
`LabelNonCompliant` = the scanned label breaks the GS1 rules (`expected`
is the reason code: `bad_check_digit`, `invalid_identifier`,
`conflicting_ais`, `missing_ai`, `unknown_ai`, ...; `actual` the raw
scan; nothing is booked); `WrongDestination` = the label's ship-to GLN
(AI 410) is not a site of this receiving (`actual` is the GLN; nothing
is booked). Neither kind has a W13 code; their CBV dispositions are
`non_conformant` and `mismatch_instance` (ADR 0024).
kind.title: CartonDiscrepancyKind

w13Code.description:
The X12 W13 receiving condition code of the finding (ADR 0023): `01`
damaged, `02` short, `03` over, `05` incorrect product, `09` hold. Two
characters, leading zero kept. Absent for a kind the standard has no code
for (`DuplicateSscc`, `UnlabelledCarton`, `CartonOverLimit`, ...); never
invented. Derived from `kind`.
w13Code.title: W13Code

cbvDisposition.description:
The GS1 CBV disposition of the finding (ADR 0023), derived from `kind`
(`damaged`, `mismatch_quantity`, `mismatch_class`, `mismatch_instance`,
`non_conformant`, ...). Always present on a coded kind.
cbvDisposition.title: CbvDisposition

supplierRef.description: The ASN's supplier; set on `LabelNonCompliant` and `WrongDestination` (ADR 0024).

400.description:
Malformed JSON or an unknown field (`malformed-request`), a bad query
parameter (`invalid-query`, `invalid-limit`, `invalid-cursor`,
`unknown-query-parameter`), a missing or malformed `Idempotency-Key`
(`idempotency-key-required`, `idempotency-key-invalid`), or a value that breaks a domain rule
(the `invalid-*`, `*-requires-*`, `duplicate-*` and
`invalid-condition`, `invalid-carton*`, `invalid-scan*`, `invalid-counted-contents`, `invalid-cases`,
`invalid-gtin`, `invalid-sscc` and `invalid-owner-ref` slugs).

schema.description: RFC 7807 problem document used for every non-2xx response.
schema.title: Problem

value.title: Malformed request
value.detail: request body is not valid JSON for this operation

value.title: Idempotency-Key header is required
value.detail: every POST must send a non-empty Idempotency-Key

value.title: SKU is invalid
value.detail: sku must be 1..64 characters without whitespace, control characters or '/'

value.title: Window is invalid
value.detail: window must end after it starts and last at most 4 hours

404.description:
The resource in the path does not exist: `asn-not-found`,
`appointment-not-found`, `receipt-not-found` or `carton-not-found`.

schema.description: RFC 7807 problem document used for every non-2xx response.

409.description:
The request conflicts with current state: `asn-already-exists`,
`asn-in-progress`, `asn-terminal`, `asn-not-receivable`,
`appointment-cancelled`, `receipt-already-open`, `receipt-closed`, `sscc-prefix-not-configured` and
`sscc-serial-exhausted` (receiver-assigned SSCCs, ADR 0024), a write that lost a race
(`concurrent-modification`), or an `Idempotency-Key` already used with
a different request (`idempotency-key-reused`).

The request is well-formed but refers to something that does not hold:
`unknown-sku`, `unknown-dock-door`,
`unknown-asn`, `unknown-appointment`,
`asn-not-on-appointment`, `line-not-on-asn`, `invalid-sscc`,
`duplicate-sscc`, `homogeneous-carton-mixed`, `carton-contents-mismatch`,
`scan-kind-mismatch`, `unsupported-pack-level`,
`counted-contents-not-mixed`, `counted-sku-unknown` or `unknown-gtin`.
